purpose: Teach: 歳月/安打/口実/地検/回生/町並み/孔/陵

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、長い歳月を経た古文書の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on the research of ancient documents spanning many years, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, observant opening. Gentle confirmation — not testing, genuinely interested. Steady eye contact. Slightly slower pace, giving space for response.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、野球選手の安打統計を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on baseball players' hit statistics.
lines.style: Polite but slightly uncertain. Quick intake of breath before speaking. Careful word choice. Ends with a small upward lift, checking if the answer was what was expected.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、政治家の口実発言の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on research into politicians' pretextual statements, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before the name. Softer than before — almost puzzled, turning something over. Listening posture. Inviting him to clarify or correct.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、東京地検特捜部の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on the history of the Tokyo District Public Prosecutors Office's Special Investigation Division.
lines.style: Quiet, matter-of-fact delivery. No defensiveness despite the mismatch. Direct but not curt. Small, genuine note under the surface — he knows something's off.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 医学部の留年生の回生指導を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You wrote your paper on advising students who were held back at medical school, didn't you?
lines.style: Slightly more engaged than before. Leaning forward subtly. Gentle warmth but with a note of genuine curiosity. Waiting to understand what's happening.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、古都の町並み保存運動を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on the preservation movement for the townscapes of old capital cities.
lines.style: Same calm, careful tone. Not stressed. A slight tightness around the eyes though — awareness that something's not matching up. He's tracking it.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、皮膚の毛穴つまり孔の微細構造を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on the microstructure of skin pores, didn't you?
lines.style: Slower now. More deliberate. Softer vowels. The tone of someone noticing a pattern and choosing her words with care. Not accusatory — genuinely wondering.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、古墳時代の陵墓発掘を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on tomb excavations from the Kofun period.
lines.style: Same measured, polite tone held throughout, but now there's a small stillness in it. He's waiting. A breath held just barely. The earnestness settling into something more like quiet acceptance.
